When RequestNeeded arrives, the client sends a SendRequest signal to a caller outside this state machine and waits 200ms for a response. When ResponseReceived arrives, it completes. If 200ms pass without a response, it sends SendRequest again. Retransmission happens at most twice, so the request is sent at most three times including the first. If there is still no response after the third request, it sends a TimeoutError signal to the caller outside the state machine and stops. The specification does not say whether the caller is the parent session of the state machine or uses another Event I/O Processor.
